# Elara Aerospace

> Elara Aerospace gGmbH is a German aerospace organization based in Garching bei München (near Munich) building reusable suborbital vehicles, rocket propulsion systems, and launch infrastructure for European research and hypersonic flight. The team of 45+ engineers develops flight hardware backed by a network of 30+ partner organizations.

Key facts:
- Hopper: VTVL (vertical takeoff, vertical landing) hopper testbed, ~650 kg liftoff mass, powered by the 7 kN TKL-7 KeraLox engine (developed with LEAP71), used to validate autonomous precision landing and rapid turnaround.
- Starlight: suborbital research rocket ("spaceshot" vehicle), up to 100 kg payload to 150 km apogee, ~10 minute flight with 3 minutes of microgravity, Mach 5, powered by a 28 kN engine.
- 28 kN engine: 28 kN electric pump-fed LOX/methane engine with regenerative cooling and a 3D-printed CuCr1Zr combustion chamber.
- TB30: launch table for engine hot fires, hold-down tests, and launch operations rehearsal.
- Payload access: Mission 01 has 50 kg total capacity, 5 kg confirmed and 45 kg available. Entry pricing is $2,500/kg for the first 20 kg; additional capacity is $4,000/kg, subject to technical review. Microgravity duration: 3 minutes. Schedule is agreed during technical review.
- Contact: team@elara-aerospace.com | HQ: Freisinger Landstr. 52, 85748 Garching, Germany.

## Vehicles & Technology

- [Hopper (VTVL hopper)](https://elara-aerospace.com/starleap.html): Testbed for autonomous landing, subsystems, TKL-7 engine.
- [Starlight (research rocket)](https://elara-aerospace.com/starlight.html): Vehicle specs, subsystems, 28 kN engine.
- [TB30 (launch table)](https://elara-aerospace.com/tb30.html): Ground-test infrastructure and capabilities.
- [Other R&D projects](https://elara-aerospace.com/other-projects.html): Avaris engine, valves, pressure regulators.
